mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 650K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 650K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 6.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average indicates supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% YoY, indicating reduced demand, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate decreased corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances when GDPC1 declines more than 1% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 50bps in a quarter and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above its 3-month moving average, the combined signal of tightening monetary policy and rising inflation leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 50bps in 1q and CPIAUCSL > 3mo MA
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 45% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month, indicating labor market weakness, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the surprise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE increases more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) increasing by more than 5% YoY, indicating strong consumer demand, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors anticipate increased corporate revenues.
evidence_refs: fact:historical retail sales and earnings correlations
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2.5-year rolling window.
